server_store: CellFileResult gains children: one { cellKey, caseId, itemId, sourceId } per retained cell, bounded by the collector cap (64).
retainCellFiles takes the item id from the existing enrolment's returned item; an enrolment that names none is refused (409), never linked to nothing.
writeEndTx keeps the children in the parent's existing plan_ref beside its plan (withCellFiles), in the same end transaction. No new table, column or migration.
withCellFiles keeps one entry per cell key and replaces, never appends, so a replay stores no reference twice. Replays reuse the same case, source and item through the existing stable request keys.
server_read: intakePlan ignores cellFiles, so the stored plan still parses under the strict plan schema.
cellFileRefs parses stored references; a row written before CN1, or an unrecognized value, yields none and the item still parses.

openCellBatchesTx (intake-context.ts) checks each child as its own batch read does: case present and not archived, item and source belong to that case, and the source receipt passes assertIntakeSource under ingestionBinding(childCaseId). Any refusal below 500 leaves the child unlinked. Two extra reads for any number of children; rows without cell files read nothing more.

IntakeService.manifest and IntakeService.one attach that result; intakeItem projects cellBatches: { cellKey, caseId, itemId, state, placement }, with caseId, itemId, state and placement null for a batch the officer may not open. The child source id is stored, never projected.
No authority check is widened; each child keeps its own case and area as CW3 designed.
contract: docs/api/openapi.json and docs/api/source-pins.json regenerated with scripts/api/refresh-contract.ts 26bc76fc; packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts regenerated with pnpm studio:api-types.
studio: IntakeTray NextStep lists a wide file's cell batches: a link 'Open the batch of cell <key>' to /studio/work/cases/<childCaseId>/intake for each batch the server named, the cell key with 'a separate batch' for any other, and 'In that batch: <state> · <placement>' when known.
The child batch page opens its single item directly (existing BatchPage behaviour).

runtime_rehearsal_should_check: Upload a wide GeoJSON (large-original path) whose features span more than one area cell; let the large intake reach its end.
The parent line lists one entry per cell file, with the lead words, and each link opens /studio/work/cases/<child>/intake showing that child's single item, layout and cards.
Each child's state on the parent line matches the child batch page after a manifest re-read.
Under a different local access context (or with a child case archived), the entry shows the cell key and 'a separate batch' with no link.
Retry or replay the parent's end: the list keeps one entry per cell and the same child cases.
A parent finished before CN1 still lists and opens without cellBatches.
open_points: A child's state change raises an event on the child case only; the parent line shows the new state at its next manifest or item read.
Parent rows finished before CN1 carry no references; they gain them only when their end is written again (an officer retry). Counts in the reason words stay as they were.
Cells held by the 64-cell cap or the 128 MiB derived receipt limit have no batch and so no entry; their counts stay in the reason words.
